title: Figure 22: Absorption/reflection plots for U-shaped complementary metamaterial absorber
description: Two side-by-side plots of absorption (left) and reflection (right) versus k (680-760 cm^-1) for V and H polarizations (blue and red lines) compared with "Smooth Au" (black line). The left plot includes a small inset rendering of a U-shaped aperture unit cell with H and V arrows. Caption: "Figure 22. Preliminary Attempts to Design a Better Absorber Using Complementary MetaMaterials (U-shaped CMM)."
